pipeline.name: daily-coordination-digest
pipeline.description: Daily Coordination Digest — Program Manager aggregates yesterday's pipeline outputs, dedupes, prioritizes, publishes to docs/daily-status.md + email

parent.title: [{{date}}] Daily Coordination Digest
description: New routine — addresses the 'too many routines, no one consolidates' problem. You aggregate yesterday's outputs, surface conflicts, publish a unified status.
## Your responsibilities (sole owner — Program Manager runs all steps)
1. read-history → 2. gather → 3. cross-agent-memory → 4. dedupe → 5. prioritize → 6. publish → 7. write-history
Output: updates `docs/daily-status.md` (single source of truth) + email digest to Luca.
Run every weekday 18:00 Europe/Rome. Skip weekends.
**Monday note**: lookback window for gather step uses 3 days (covers Sat+Sun+Fri evening) instead of 24h. The pipeline auto-adjusts via the `gather` step's SQL.
- Do NOT post status comments like 'I'm starting' or 'I'm blocked' — the task status (`todo`/`in_progress`/`blocked`/`done`) already conveys this.
- Each step posts EXACTLY ONE comment: the structured output. The same comment also @mentions the next agent if applicable.
- Orchestrator (you, when applicable) consolidates verification + transition + @mention next agent into ONE comment per handoff.
- The parent task gets at most 2 comments per run: 'pipeline started' (optional) and final summary at close.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Coord Digest — Read history
description: ## Pull last 14 days of digest history
node scripts/tools/pipeline-memory.mjs recall daily-coordination-digest 'recurring conflicts, unresolved priorities, blockers, agent performance' --limit 14 --days 14

**If recall exits non-zero**: do NOT block the pipeline. Instead, post a warning comment ('Memory recall failed: <error>. Proceeding without historical context for this run.') and continue with the rest of the steps using only current data. Only block the pipeline if the WRITE step (last task) fails — that's where we'd lose this run's learning forever. Exit codes: 3 = Ollama unavailable (most common, transient), 2 = network/auth (catastrophic, escalate to Founding Engineer).
- Items flagged but not resolved over multiple days (escalation candidates)
- Recurring conflict themes (same agents bumping into each other)
- Pipelines that produced unusual output yesterday
- **Yesterday's memory ID** — you'll update its `outcome:` tag in step 7 based on what you observe today
Post recall + 3-bullet summary. Set task to done.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Coord Digest — Gather recent outputs
description: ## Pull all issues created since yesterday (or last 3 days on Monday)
**Lookback adaptive logic**: on Monday, query 3 days back (covers Sat+Sun) — every other day, 1 day. Note: today is **{{weekday}}**.

psql -U luca -d paperclip -At -c "SELECT row_to_json(t) FROM (SELECT i.identifier, i.title, a.name AS assignee, i.priority, i.status, i.created_at::date AS created FROM issues i LEFT JOIN agents a ON a.id = i.assignee_agent_id WHERE i.company_id = 'cdb3c45d-c7df-4ea0-b495-26426a1e9df4' AND i.created_at > NOW() - (INTERVAL '1 day' * $DAYS_BACK) ORDER BY i.created_at DESC) t"
Output is one JSON object per line — robust to titles with `|` or other special chars.
Group by source pipeline (parse from title prefix `[YYYY-MM-DD] <pipeline>`).
## Issues created in last $DAYS_BACK day(s): total N
- Daily SEO Optimization: N issues (X open, Y done)

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Coord Digest — Read cross-agent memory
description: ## Search all agents' recent memories for blockers and conflicts
node scripts/tools/memory-harvest.mjs recall 'blocked, waiting, conflict, cannot proceed, regression' 2>&1 | head -100

If memory-harvest fails or Ollama is unavailable, proceed with a degraded note: 'Cross-agent memory unavailable — coordination based on yesterday\'s issues only'. Do NOT block the entire digest on this — it's an enrichment, not a hard requirement.
Identify any agent that explicitly mentioned being blocked, waiting on someone, or detecting a conflict in last 7 days.
- Conflicts detected (same asset touched by multiple)

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Coord Digest — Dedupe and cluster
description: ## Cluster yesterday's issues by theme and dedupe
Read [{{gather_outputs.identifier}}] issue list. For each issue, identify which theme it belongs to:
Look for duplicates (e.g., 2 issues touching same article). Mark dupes for closure with cross-link.
Post comment with: theme clusters + dupe pairs.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Coord Digest — Top 5-10 priorities for tomorrow
description: ## Decide what matters most for tomorrow
From all gathered + clustered issues, pick the top 5-10 that matter for tomorrow. Criteria:
3. Items mentioned in escalation memory (>2 days unresolved)
Post comment with prioritized list and 1-line rationale per item.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Coord Digest — Publish status doc + email
description: ## Update docs/daily-status.md (PR + reviewer) and email Luca
Use this template (fill in real values from prior steps):
_Updated by Program Manager via daily-coordination-digest pipeline._
- N issues created across M pipelines
- X urgent | Y high | Z medium
git checkout main && git pull origin main
# write the new docs/daily-status.md content (use Write tool or heredoc)

PR_URL=$(gh pr create --repo nio85/superdots-blog --base main --reviewer nio85 --title 'coord: daily status digest {{date}}' --body 'Daily Coordination Digest. Reviewer: Founding Engineer (or CEO as fallback per CLAUDE.md review matrix).')
**Do NOT auto-merge.** PR goes through normal review (Founding Engineer for `coord/*`, CEO fallback). Reviewer mergi when CI is green.
**If git push or PR creation fails** (`set -e` catches): set this task to `blocked` with the error in the comment. DO NOT proceed to email.
## Step 3 — Email Luca (only if step 2 succeeded)
Use the existing email pattern. Adapt from `scripts/send-published-articles.mjs` (it shows how to load Resend SMTP via config.mjs and send markdown content). Suggested inline approach:
# Save the digest content to $TMPMAIL (the same content you put in docs/daily-status.md)
await t.sendMail({ from: MAIL_FROM, to: TO_EMAIL, subject: 'SuperDots digest {{date}}', text: md });
If email send fails, post the error as comment but still set task to done — PR is the primary deliverable, email is enhancement.
Comment with PR URL. Set task to done.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Coord Digest — Write history
description: Based on what you observed today vs yesterday's predictions (top priorities resolved? blockers persisted?), update yesterday's outcome. The helper auto-finds the prior run.
# Replace <yesterday-memory-id> with the actual ID. Use 'good' if predictions held, 'neutral' if mixed, 'negative' if priorities slipped.
node scripts/tools/pipeline-memory.mjs update-outcome-latest daily-coordination-digest good  # auto-finds prior run, idempotent
If yesterday was the first run (no prior memory), skip this step.
# Use cat > $TMPFILE <<'EOF' ... EOF, or the Write tool, to write the markdown content below to $TMPFILE
- <prediction> — will be checked in next-day's read-history outcome update
node scripts/tools/pipeline-memory.mjs write daily-coordination-digest --content "$TMPFILE" --outcome pending --agent PROGRAM_MANAGER --tag domain:coord
**If write exits 4** (NULL embedding — Ollama down): set task to `blocked` and notify on-call.
**If write exits 2 or 5**: investigate and retry; set task to `blocked` if cannot resolve.
**Only on exit 0**: set task and parent to done.
